verdicts.reason: Both cram the full portrait layout into a tiny banner. In each, the headline wraps to three lines on the left, while the body copy and legal text on the right are shrunk past legibility. The legal text is nearly as large as the body copy, so the hierarchy is flat. Neither shows the SOLSTICE sun logo clearly, and the CTA pill is tiny and buried. B is marginally better because it keeps the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow and arranges the copy column a little more cleanly, but it has the same unreadable-text and cramming failures as A.
